summary.motive: Exploit Buck Sweep's tendency with an opposite-direction counter whose backfield action crossfaces every flow defender.
summary.whyItWorks: The crisscross puts a ballcarrier fake moving both directions simultaneously, and the trey pullers arrive on the real play's edge before anyone redirects.
summary.failureMode: Disciplined spill-and-scrape linebackers stay home on the crossface, letting them meet the counter in the hole with the pullers still trailing.

beats.title: 1. The Crisscross Backfield
beats.text: The quarterback opens right and fakes the sweep to B while the wing loops behind him the other way — two backs crossing paths directly in front of every linebacker's key.

beats.title: 2. The Trey Pullers
beats.text: The guard pulls to kick the end while the tackle wraps behind him as the leader — identical footwork to Buck Sweep pointed the other direction.

beats.title: 3. Crossfacing Chaos
beats.text: The Will, Sam, and strong end are all chasing decoys to the right while the hidden handoff hits the counter hole behind them.

beats.title: 4. The Counter Hits Left
beats.text: The wing bursts through the kick-out seam behind the wrapping tackle. Only the Mike read it correctly — and the puller buries him anyway.

relations.tell: The quarterback reverses his shoulder mid-play to hand off backward — live sweeps and boots never change the ballcarrier after the initial mesh.
